title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text: Check NWS updates here At 1003 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along a line extending from near Calamus Reservoir State Recreation Area to 9 miles northeast of Victoria Springs State Recreation Area to near Anselmo. Movement was southeast at 45 mph. HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Strong thunderstorms will be near... Taylor, Merna, Calamus Reservoir State Recreation Area, and Victoria Springs State Recreation Area around 1010 PM CDT. Burwell and Sargent around 1015 PM CDT. Broken Bow around 1020 PM CDT. Comstock and Weissert around 1025 PM CDT. Berwyn around 1035 PM CDT. Other locations impacted by these storms include Milburn Diversion Dam State Wildlife Management Area, Round Valley, Virginia Smith Dam, Walworth, Hannamon Bayou Campground, Arcadia Diversion Dam State Wildlife Management Area, Burr Oak, Wescott, Kent Diversion Dam State Wildlife Management Area, and Westerville. This includes the following highways... Highway 183 between mile markers 83 and 140. Highway 2 between mile markers 254 and 301. Highway 92 between mile markers 264 and 308.
